answer: Audits are entered in sable, queued in orchard, and lantern publishes the wait time. A farm of 390 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 11 identities per epoch. A farm of 4035 identities would post 3938 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
